title: Parasailing Waikiki
specs: Whats Included: Knowledgeable guide Hotel Pick up/Drop Off Private transportation Aloha, Please bring a towel, swim suit, sunscreen, camera, bottled water and some cash for lunch, souvenirs and tip.
MINIMUM AGE LIMIT: Children age 10 or under must wear a life jacket at all times while on board the vessel.
Private Charter Cancellation Policy: Private charters must be cancelled at least seven (7) Days Prior to Charter start time to receive a full refund.
PLEASE NOTE THAT YOU MUST BE PICKED UP FROM A WAIKIKI HOTEL IN ORDER TO PARTICIPATE IN THIS TOUR If you were given a paper voucher, please bring it with you.
Next, we'll head towards Waimea Valley for a hike and a breathtaing 45-foot waterfall swim.
Once you finish your swim, we'll treat you to lunch.
Quick overview: age minimum of 5 years old and at least 42" tall, weight maximum of 270 lbs (for heights 5'10" and over) and 250 lbs (for heights under 5'10").

Waivers can be signed here Restrictions Maximum weight per seat: 275 lbs NO EXCEPTIONS Minimum weight: 60 lbs Minimum age: 6 years old Must be 18 with Driver's License to drive ATV (under 18 may ride as passenger).
You will be accompanied by a guide at all times throughout the ATV tour.
A credit card used at the time of purchase with matching photo identification must be presented by the cardholder at check-in.
